title: The Joining of Fire and Lightning
summary: A treatise for students who hold two streams: it joins fire to lightning so that heat and sudden force arrive in one stroke.

title: The Treatise of Fire Carried by Wind
summary: A treatise on feeding fire with moving air and shaping air with fire until each lifts and steers the other.

title: The Compendium of Opposed Fires
tradition: fire with earth and water fusion
summary: A compendium for the formed Core on bridging fire with the opposed streams of earth and water into stone-baked heat and scalding vapor.

title: The Fire and Life Canon
summary: A canon for the formed Core that joins thermal energy to the living body so that heat nourishes and cleanses as readily as it burns.
